BUG 2 (the genuine capture-lane surface work), distinct from and STACKED ON TOP OF fz-k22.8 (clause-0 demand, bug 1). Confirmed via spike wt-spike-k22b (2026-07-09): with bug 1 fixed, enum_predicate_search now fails on a distinct pre-existing codegen bug -- NativeClosureTargetSurface { capture_count: 1, capture_reprs: [RawAtom] } vs { 0, [] } at native_codegen/driver.rs:940 -- a direct closure-call fast path encoding 1 capture lane where the callee target expects 0/2. Ground-folding of closure captures disagrees across call sites.

INDEPENDENCE CONFIRMED: reproduces on UNTOUCHED fixtures2/00279_enum_find_find_value.fz and at HEAD baseline. SHARED BUG FAMILY: identical NativeClosureTargetSurface assertion at driver.rs:940 holds enum_take_drop_split::{run,build} red -- so fixing this greens TWO matrix fixtures at once.

CORRECT LOCUS = native codegen closure-target SURFACE unification (driver.rs:940), NOT the demand seam. The earlier fix (a) attempt (route through CallEdge::Indirect, thread aggregate capture-surface multiplicity through arg_demands_for_summary) dead-ended on phase-ordering (capture-surface fact lives in transport-layer BoundaryDescr, downstream of the demand seam). Re-diagnose from the SETTLED state that lands only after fz-k22.8. BLOCKED BY fz-k22.8 (must land first to expose the settled non-crashing state this bug lives in).

FIXTURE PATH: fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.{fz,expected.txt,oracle.exs} (discovered by tests/fixture_matrix.rs via fixtures2/behavior).

comments.text:
ADVANCED (not green) via spike 2026-07-09. TWO LAYERS, one step (neither greens a fixture alone -> one commit when both land):

LAYER 1 (prototyped, preserved on branch wt/k22-7-capture-lane @ 66d99ec40): native.rs BackendTail::ClosureCall hard-errored on direct_rejection instead of falling through to the already-correct generic indirect path. Deleting the redundant hard-error (~12 LoC) moves BOTH enum_predicate_search AND enum_take_drop_split past the 'encoded N call lanes for M callee params' error to fail IDENTICALLY at layer 2 -- proving they share one root bug. lib 1279/0/6, warning-free.

LAYER 2 (root-caused, NOT fixed -- the cheap fix is UNSOUND): driver.rs:940 build_codegen_closure_targets asserts one NativeClosureTargetSurface per target_fn. Two BoundaryIds (per closure-literal call site: all?/2 captures a fun -> 1 RawAtom lane; all?/1 ground-folds to 0 lanes) resolve to the same shared recursive body with divergent published_capture_lanes. That target_fn->surface map ALSO compiles the callee's OWN entry ABI (one physical param layout), so 'pick one, skip conflict' trades a clean crash for a silent miscompile. Correct fix must unify capture lanes at the boundary-publication layer (transport) + make the ground-folded 0-capture producer materialize the folded constant into the widened slot -- needs fixpoint-safety review.

NOW: holistic root-cause investigation underway (Output Contract Loop) on wt-k22-7-holistic to trace where the DATA MODEL first goes sour (is capture-surface held at the wrong granularity? is the body-sharing decision ignoring capture ABI? is the ground-fold the rot?) and design the correct-by-construction repair. Full data-model diagnosis to replace this when it returns.

HOLISTIC ROOT-CAUSE (Output Contract Loop, 2026-07-09). Checkpoint on branch wt/k22-7-capture-lane @ 03686dc64 (transport re-grounding + FZ_K22_7_TRACE telemetry, on top of 66d99ec40 layer-1).

THE ROOT (one idea, conflated at TWO layers): capture ABI is a property of the TARGET BODY (ExecutableKey = FunctionId + activation arrow), NOT of the reference/edge that names it. A compiled native fn has ONE physical entry block; its capture surface belongs to the body. The model attaches capture facts to the wrong entity in two places:

LAYER A (transport facts): BoundaryDescr.published_capture_lanes (transport.rs:251) is per-boundary/per-producer. A concrete producer boundary (CallableId with function:Some, 1 lane) and a generic POOLING boundary (function:None, built in generic_shape_from_demand) can legitimately resolve to the SAME target while carrying divergent capture facts. generic_shape_from_demand stamps a hardcoded &[] (transport.rs:3619) ignoring the callable's own capture_lanes. No invariant enforces 'boundaries sharing a target agree on capture surface'. FIX (prototyped, ~80 LoC, backend.rs concrete_target_capture_surfaces): source capture surface ONLY from concrete (function:Some) producer boundaries, keyed by resolved target; every boundary reads that one map. Pure re-grounding of an existing fact onto its rightful owner -- NO widening, no monotonicity risk. Eliminates the driver.rs:928 assertion. lib 1279/0/6, clippy clean.

LAYER B (native calling-convention): driver.rs:950-983 re-derives capture count from raw Term::CallClosure{direct_target, args}.len(). The bare direct_target: Option<FnId> CONFLATES 'genuinely devirtualized (args include captures)' vs 'hint-only indirect (args exclude captures; loaded from boxed env)'. The layer-1 fallback (native.rs:1084-1096) deliberately routes disagreeing surfaces to indirect-with-hint, but the type can't express it, so driver.rs's second loop misapplies direct-call arithmetic to hint-only sites -> still crashes at driver.rs:977. FIX SHAPE: make the distinction explicit in the type -- replace Option<FnId> with enum { Devirtualized(FnId), IndirectHint(FnId) } so codegen's consistency check handles hint-only sites by construction.

FALSIFIER to confirm BEFORE building layer B: is Term::CallClosure.direct_target EVER used for genuine direct native dispatch, or ALWAYS hint-only? If always hint-only -> driver.rs:950-983 is dead/wrong code to DELETE (north star), not an enum to add. Confirm first.

STATE: root grokked (both layers = same idea). Layers 1 + A prototyped on branch. Layer B needs the falsifier resolved -> then delete-dead-loop OR typed-enum split. All of it greens BOTH enum_predicate_search AND enum_take_drop_split -> ONE commit (one step). Telemetry FZ_K22_7_TRACE gated behind compiler2::k22_7_trace_enabled(), REMOVE when the real fix lands.

LAYER B DONE (delete-case), branch @ e4876d3dd. Falsifier resolved: Term::CallClosure/TailCallClosure.direct_target is NEVER a genuine direct native dispatch -- always a devirtualization HINT for call_indirect (call.rs:203-206 doc; terminator.rs emit_call_closure only ever emits call_indirect/return_call_indirect for Some AND None; native.rs:1084-1096). So enum-split would be a distinction without a difference; correct fix = DELETE the misapplied arithmetic. driver.rs build_codegen_closure_targets second loop now skips any target_fn already covered by Layer A's authoritative boundary walk (21 LoC); the loop's only remaining job is a fallback surface for targets owning zero callable boundaries. lib 1279/0/6, clippy clean, full matrix = exactly the 10 known-red (nothing new).

REMAINING LAYERS (same root: target identity lost to pooling), all blocking full green:
- LAYER C (native emission): native.rs ~3330-3344 never inserts callable_value_boundaries entry when callable_has_boundaries(callable) is false; prim.rs:2273-2294 settled_callable_boundary_id requires it -> 'native callable value Var(N) has no settled callable boundary'. Needs a boundary-less fallback for closures that never escape first-class. Affects enum_predicate_search AND repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2 (run+build).
- LAYER D (interpreter): ir_interp/backend.rs:2857 most_specialized_callable_targets ambiguous when >=2 candidates share (fn_id, capture_count, arg_count) and neither dominates -- interp's version of arity-keyed pooling losing target identity. Affects enum_predicate_search::interp + enum_take_drop_split::interp.
- RETURN-ARITY VERIFIER BUG (LIKELY SEPARATE family, NOT capture-ABI): cranelift verifier reduce_while_cont return_call fn6 got 4 args expected 5 -- a DIRECT call in a reduce_while continuation. Blocks enum_take_drop_split run/build. Needs own root-cause; may connect to fz-k22.8 reduce_while_cont demand territory.

DRIVING C+D now (fully greens enum_predicate_search all 3 backends); root-causing the verifier bug to decide k22.7-family vs separate ticket.
